Interface IConnectionStatusListener

All Superinterfaces:
ISubscriberListener
public interface IConnectionStatusListener extends ISubscriberListener

The listener interface for receiving events for the stored and live data handler.

E.g. to wait until all the stored data has been received, and to log the state of the live connection: 

CountDownLatch storedDataReceived = new CountDownLatch(1);

raceSubscriber.subscribeConnectionStatus(new IConnectionStatusListener() {
    public void gotStoredDataEvent(IStoredDataEvent storedDataEvent) {
        if (storedDataEvent.getType() == IStoredDataEvent.Type.End
                || storedDataEvent.getType() == IStoredDataEvent.Type.Error) {
            storedDataReceived.countDown();
        }
    }

    public void gotLiveDataEvent(ILiveDataEvent liveDataEvent) {
        System.out.println("Live data: " + liveDataEvent.getStatusType());
    }

    public void stopped(Object subscribedObject) {
    }
});

raceSubscriber.start();
storedDataReceived.await();
